text: Praise ye Jah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
I will praise Jehovah in my life; I will play on the harp to my God in my continuing.
Ye shall not trust in nobles: in the son of man, to him no salvation.
His spirit shall go forth, he shall turn back to his earth; in that day his thoughts perished.
Happy is he the God of Jacob for his help, his hope upon Jehovah his God:
He made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them: he watched the truth forever.
He did judgment for the oppressed; he gave bread to the hungering: Jehovah loosed those being bound.
Jehovah opened the eyes of the blind: Jehovah raised those being bowed down: Jehovah loved the just.
Jehovah watched the strangers he will restore the orphan and the widow, and he will overturn the way of the unjust.
Jehovah shall reign forever, thy God, O Zion, to generation and generation. Praise ye Jah.
